intro: Our Edius Pro editing services support demanding production schedules by combining the software's native multi-format capabilities with AI-assisted workflows and human editorial oversight.

servicesHeader.title: Edius Pro Video Editing Services - Accelerated by AI-Led Workflows
servicesHeader.description: Key operational capabilities for broadcasters and production companies that need consistent multi-format delivery.

services.title: Real-time Conversion Rendering
items: Real-time conversion rendering from standard definition to high definition, supported by AI-assisted format-queue management to reduce wait times and lower conversion-related operational costs.

services.title: Native Multi-format Compatibility
items: Native multi-format compatibility across professional camera sources, with AI-assisted ingestion workflows that help reduce manual effort on footage conversion and organization.

services.title: Unlimited Track Support
items: Unlimited video, audio, title, and graphics track support for long-form and complex productions, with human editors maintaining continuity review at each assembly stage.

services.title: Real-time Audio and Video Editing
items: Real-time audio and video editing execution with human quality checkpoints applied before delivery to help reduce rework requests and maintain output consistency.

services.title: Transitions and Nested Timelines
items: Real-time rendering of transitions and titles, plus nested timeline sequencing supported by structured workflow organization to improve efficiency across longer productions.

services.title: Multi-camera and Broadcast Output
items: Multi-camera editing of up to 16 simultaneous sources, high-definition output support, alpha channel export workflows, and direct export to Blu-ray, DVD, media cards, and 3D formats with human validation.

faqs.question: Who is Edius Pro editing best suited for?
faqs.answer: Broadcasters, production companies, and post-production teams that need multi-format editing, multi-cam assembly, and reliable delivery across complex timelines.

faqs.question: Does Video Caddy use AI in Edius Pro workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI-assisted ingestion and format-queue management accelerate preparation, while human editors review continuity and quality before delivery.

faqs.question: What outputs can be delivered from Edius Pro projects?
faqs.answer: Projects can be delivered in high-definition broadcast formats and exported to Blu-ray, DVD, media cards, and other approved destinations after editor validation.
